# Cncf Alibaba Cloud Function Compute Reviewer

Review Alibaba Cloud Function Compute using its official documentation and repository in the Serverless / Hosted Platform category. A fully hosted and serverless running environment that takes away the need to manage infrastructure such as servers and enables developers to focus on writing and uploading code.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
